scope: Operation-driven uploads, twenty-minute continuous-playback safety checkpoint, local progress saving and worker intent gating
Per-device latest checkpoints, explicit selection of an older source and retention of other devices
Shared device renaming without advancing playback checkpoints; automatic and manual invitations with refreshed UI
Favorite folder/video removal, cancellation, rejection and ambiguous outcomes without replay
Discover cover long press and short-video account recommendation feedback
Four-corner floating video resize, move and return without media reload
Music queue per-track favorites and play-next, current-song location, drag preview and edge scrolling with one persisted drop
Explicit record/lyrics/original faces, subtitle sound marker filtering and silent on-demand picture without replacing primary audio
Music, comments, favorite creation, phone fullscreen gestures and tablet layout regressions
limitations: Android 15 emulators; physical devices were not tested for this release.
Synthetic platform tests do not establish actual account-write acceptance or recommendation algorithm effects.
0.2.5 WebDAV/coordinator tests use isolated in-memory transport; a separate 0.2.3 protocol probe is not full current end-to-end validation.
OS force-stop, background restrictions and loss of power/network can delay uploads.
